## v0.8.10 — Full-flash image & docs

**Firmware** now publishes a **merged full-flash** binary (`cardputer_adv_firmware-*-merged.bin`, flash at **0x0**) alongside the app-only image at 0x10000 — for M5Burner, bmorcelli Launcher catalog, and one-shot `esptool` writes. Verified booting on a real Cardputer-Adv.

**Docs:** README refresh (hero badges, app-switching demo GIF, simulator stills, companion screenshots, Install quick-start table). Repository is **Apache-2.0**.

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.10** (Companion versionCode 12). Companion behavior is unchanged.

`cardputer_adv_firmware-0.8.10.bin` · `cardputer_adv_firmware-0.8.10-merged.bin` · `CardputerCompanion-0.8.10.apk`

Serial boot line: `cardputer_adv_firmware 0.8.10`

**Full diff:** https://github.com/bluedskim/cardputer_adv_firmware/compare/v0.8.9...v0.8.10
